idea-plugin.name: Twig Arcs: Matching Tag & Branch Highlighting
idea-plugin.description:
Highlights matching Twig tags and the branches of {% if %} / {% elseif %} / {% else %}, so you can see at a glance where a block starts and ends and which code belongs together. Made for long Twig templates, such as Drupal and Symfony themes.

  • Arcs for every block: dotted curves connect the tags of each if, for, block, macro, embed ... One arc per branch, so if/elseif/else reads like an inverted "3". The arcs use the indentation and the gutter, and nest.
  • Branch highlighting: put the caret in a branch and it turns green; the other branches of the same block turn red and their content is greyed out.
  • Same condition elsewhere: other if blocks with the same condition are decided too: branches that cannot run together with the caret's line turn red, branches that are taken become green (alternating with blue if it is unknown whether the code gets there). Respects not, {% set %} and loop iterations.
  • Matching tag highlighting: with the caret on a Twig tag, all tags of the same block are highlighted, e.g. {% if %} with its {% else %} and {% endif %}.
  • Tag backgrounds: a pale background on {% %} tags sets Twig logic apart from markup; optional for {{ }} and {# #}.

All colors can be changed or turned off in Settings | Editor | Color Scheme | Twig Arcs. Folding is not touched.
